### Bug 1: Interview breaks after Q4 — pauses and restarts recording repeatedly
- After answering the 4th question, the interview paused and started recording again and again in a loop
- User was forced to click End because it wouldn't progress naturally
- Investigate what causes the recording loop/restart after Q4 — likely a state management bug in the conversation flow or mic/recording handler

### Bug 2: Body language analysis completely failed — all defaults
- Despite camera being ON the entire session (REC indicator visible in screenshots)
- Feedback page shows ALL body language scores at 5/10 with "Video analysis temporarily unavailable"
- "Video analysis could not be completed" error message shown
- Frame capture or GPT-4o vision analysis is failing silently — investigate why

### Bug 3: Remove AI lines from transcript — only show user's answers
- Currently transcript shows both AI and user speech
- User wants ONLY their own answers in the transcript
- Remove AI interviewer lines from the transcript display (both live and in feedback)

### Bug 4: Feedback generation too slow + move video analysis to background/async
- User had to wait a long time after ending the interview for feedback to appear
- **Move video/body language analysis to background processing** — do NOT block feedback on video analysis
- Generate content-based feedback (scores, strengths, improvements) immediately on End
- Body language results can be delivered asynchronously (show "Body language analysis processing..." and update when ready, or show on next page load)
- This also helps Bug 2 — if video analysis fails, content feedback still shows instantly

### Bug 5: AI interviewer response too slow — long wait between questions
- After candidate finishes answering, there's a very long delay before the AI asks the next question
- User is sitting and waiting with nothing happening
- Investigate the pipeline: candidate audio → Whisper transcription → GPT evaluation → GPT next question → TTS generation → playback
- Optimize: use streaming TTS, pre-generate follow-up questions while candidate is still speaking, reduce unnecessary API round-trips
- Consider using GPT-4o-mini for faster response generation during the interview (full GPT-4o can be used for final feedback)
- Add a visual "AI is thinking..." indicator so user knows something is happening during the delay

### Phase 1: Fix interview breaking after Q4 + speed up AI response
- Debug the conversation state machine — why does it pause and restart recording after Q4
- Fix the recording loop so interview flows naturally through all ~8 questions
- Optimize the response pipeline to minimize delay between candidate answer and next AI question
- Use streaming TTS, consider GPT-4o-mini for in-interview responses
- Add "AI is thinking..." indicator during processing
- **DEPLOY. TEST.**

### Phase 2: Fix body language analysis failure
- Debug why frame capture/GPT-4o vision analysis fails despite camera being on
- Check if frames are actually being captured and sent to the API
- Check for API errors, timeouts, or silent failures
- **DEPLOY. TEST.**

### Phase 3: Remove AI lines from transcript
- Filter out AI interviewer speech from the transcript display
- Only show the candidate's spoken answers in both live transcript and feedback transcript
- **DEPLOY. TEST.**

### Phase 4: Make feedback instant — async video analysis
- Decouple video/body language analysis from main feedback generation
- On End click: immediately generate content feedback (scores, strengths, tips)
- Video analysis runs in background — results appear when ready or on next visit
- User should NOT wait for video analysis to see their feedback
